title: Sherbet
tagline: Swap two sweets, line up three, and hope it keeps going.
description: A match-three with a sweet shop's worth of colour. Swap any two neighbours to line up three or more and they burst; whatever is above drops into the gap, which is where the good runs come from — one swap setting off four collapses in a row. Line up four and you get a striped sweet that clears a whole line; five makes something that clears every sweet of one colour. Sixty levels, each with its own target and a fixed number of moves to hit it.
author: HexCave
controls: Tap or click two neighbours to swap
Drag a sweet onto its neighbour
howToPlay: Swap two neighbouring sweets to line up three or more of a colour.
A swap that lines nothing up is not allowed, and does not cost a move.
Match four for a striped sweet that clears a line; match five for something better.
goal: Hit each level’s target before the moves run out. Cascades and special sweets are where the points are.
